title: A filter on a single fact column does not filter the dimension
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "Products", CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Product ), Sales[Quantity] >= 3 ) )

source.quote: it will not spread its effects to the whole Product table, as a filter on Sales did
source.supports: a filter on the Sales[Quantity] column alone does not spread to Product

source.quote: a filter on Customer automatically filters Sales, whereas a filter on Sales propagates neither to Product nor to Customer or Date
source.supports: a filter on Sales does not propagate to Product through a single-direction relationship

derivation: The predicate filters only the column Sales[Quantity]. It is not a filter on the expanded Sales table, and the relationship is single direction, so Product keeps its 4 rows.
notes: Compare filter-over-fact-table-reaches-dimensions, where the same condition through FILTER ( Sales, ... ) gives 1.
